heading: Office of Electronic Government
lead: The Office of Electronic Government, established under section 3602 of title 44, is an office in the Office of Management and Budget.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective 120 days after Dec. 17, 2002, see section 402(a)(1) of Pub. L. 107–347, set out as a note under section 3601 of Title 44, Public Printing and Documents.
